bandRule: Rank I is the affix's existing affixes.json range. Each later band starts one above the previous maximum and spans ceil(rankIMax / 2) values, so rank V tops out near 3x rank I. type_focus reproduces the specification's Fire Focus example. Values are placeholders until the balance pass.

uniques.name: Ashen Heart
uniques.benefit: Burns you inflict deal 50% more damage.
uniques.drawback: Your direct move damage is reduced by 15%.

uniques.name: Last Breath
uniques.benefit: Once per battle, survive a lethal hit from an opposing move with 1 HP.
uniques.drawback: All healing you receive is halved.

uniques.name: Creeping Venom
uniques.benefit: Regular poison you inflict deals 20% more for each turn it has already lasted, up to 80%.
uniques.drawback: You take 20% more damage from Psychic moves.

uniques.name: Stormcaller
uniques.benefit: While a weather is active, your moves of the weather's type deal 30% more damage.
uniques.drawback: With no weather active, your direct move damage is reduced by 15%.

uniques.name: Rupture
uniques.benefit: Your physical moves always cause bleeding.
uniques.drawback: Bleed you inflict is weaker per stack: 100%, 80%, 60%.

uniques.name: Titan's Heart
uniques.benefit: Your super-effective moves deal extra damage equal to 10% of your maximum HP.
uniques.drawback: You cannot be healed in battle.

uniques.benefit: Item rewards you earn are 20% larger while it is in your party.
uniques.drawback: You take 25% more damage from moves (about 20% less effective HP).
